newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SEREVI DAZZLES FOR WORLD XV.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SEREVI DAZZLES FOR WORLD XV.

text.p: A dazzling individual performance by Sevens specialist Waisale Serevi helped a World XV to a 52-31 victory over English league champions Wasps at Twickenham on Saturday.
The diminutive Fijian scored a hat-trick to crown a superb afternoon of running rugby which produced 12 tries.
The World XV, captained by France's Philippe Sella, were level at 17-17 at halftime but pulled clear after the break.
Australians David Campese and Willie Ofahengaue and Sella himself all scored before another Fijian made his mark.
Winger Marika Vanbuka, a second half substitute, grabbed two late tries to put the result beyond doubt.
Wasps, missing seven regulars on international duty with England, Scotland and the British Lions, scored four tries through Kenny Logan (2), Shane Rosier and Buster White.
